title: IALA buoyage: lateral and cardinal marks explained
h1: Buoys and marks: the IALA system
lead: Buoys show where the channel runs and which side of a danger is safe. This guide covers the IALA marks you will meet in the Mediterranean, by day and at night.
description: Lateral, cardinal, isolated danger, safe water and special marks in IALA Region A: colours, topmarks, light rhythms and how to read a light on the chart.
summary: In Region A, coming in from sea, red can marks are left to port and green cones to starboard.
Cardinal topmarks point to the black on the mark. Pass on the side the mark is named after.
Cardinal lights follow a clock face: east 3 flashes, south 6 and a long flash, west 9, north continuous.
Buoys drag, go missing and may be unlit, so check every mark against the chart.
